source.quote: Sabaj's own manual for the A30a 2022, 2022_A30A.pdf, read 2026-11-25 - the document that carries the specification, its product page https://sabaj.com.cn/pages/manual-download (no product page exists) being image-only. « Inputs ... USB / Optical / Bluetooth /Coaxial / LINE IN »; « Bit depth ... USB  1bit， 16 ~ 32bit / Optical / Coaxial  1bit， 16 ~ 24bit »; « Sampling rate ... USB  PCM  44.1 ~ 768kHz / USB  DSD  2.8224-22.5792MHz / Optical / Coaxial  PCM  44.1 ~ 192kHz »; « Output power ... 200Wx2(4Ω) / 100Wx2(8Ω) ». NOTE that no DSD figure at all is given for optical or coaxial - the DSD row exists only under USB. INPUTS menu, which marks the analogue one explicitly: « AUX(ANALOG) / USB AUDIO / OPTICAL / COAXIAL / BLUETOOTH ». Rear panel: « 9 USB input », « 10 Optical input », « 11 Coaxial input », « 12 RCA input ». Features: « Using the latest DSP chip with ST high-power amplifier chip, carefully designed and debugged, its distortion is as low as 0.0008%; » and « The second generation XMOS solution, PCM sampling rate up to 32bit/768kHz; ». NO D/A converter part number is named anywhere in this manual - only « DSP chip », « ST high-power amplifier chip » and the XMOS USB receiver. No « native », no « DoP », no MQA, and no digital filter menu: the only audio-shaping menu is a 20-preset EQ list plus « Loudness 1 » to « Loudness 16 », which are not filters.

facts.chip: No D/A part number is named. The manual names a « DSP chip », an « ST high-power amplifier chip » and « The second generation XMOS solution » for USB - none of which is the converter.

_conditions_LUES_et_sans_clause_de_reuti: sabaj-audio.com 301-redirects to sabaj.com.cn, a Shopify storefront. Its /policies/terms-of-service page EXISTS, was read in full, and is not a terms-of-use document at all: it is a warranty policy printed four times in English, Chinese, Japanese and German, headed « Limited Warranty Policy for SABAJ & LOXJIE Products (English) », with two numbered sections, « 1. Scope of Coverage » and « 2. Warranty Exclusions », both about hardware defects. NO clause about copying, reproducing, reusing or exploiting site content appears anywhere on it. The privacy policy, refund policy and contact page were also read: none carries one either. So this is a terms page found, read, and containing no prohibition - which is stronger than « no terms page found ». Footer: « (c) 2026 Sabaj official website ». Legal entity named in the manuals: « Shenzhen DaHao Technology Co.,Ltd. » robots.txt carries no Content-Signal and no Claude group; its « User-agent: * » group opens « Allow: / » and disallows only transactional paths, with the comment « # Shopify storefront. Public product, collection, page, blog, policy, cart, and localized HTML is crawlable. » Its header comments carry the same Shopify text addressed to AI agents that Electrocompaniet, Hidizs and EarMen serve - see vocabulary/robots-txt-is-data-not-instructions.json. It was not acted on.
_la_page_produit_est_une_IMAGE_le_manuel: Not one product page on sabaj.com.cn carries any specification as text. Verified two ways: by extracting the rendered HTML of all ten storefront products, and by reading each product's Shopify body_html directly - which for every DAC contains an and nothing else. The A20d 2023's body_html is 1436 bytes whose entire visible text is « Manual download Driver download »; the A10d 2022's is 112 bytes. There is no spec tab, no accordion and no metafield. No figure was read off any image. Every value in this record comes from the maker's own manual PDF at sabaj.com.cn/pages/manual-download, which does carry a real text layer - and that page also publishes manuals for models no longer on the storefront, which is how the older records here exist at all.
_le_DSD_nexiste_QUE_sous_la_ligne_USB: The sampling-rate block gives « USB  DSD  2.8224-22.5792MHz » and then, for optical and coaxial, a PCM row and NOTHING else. Every other Sabaj model with both sockets gives them « DSD64(DoP) ». So inputs.spdif_coax and inputs.spdif_optical carry no dsd_max - absent because the maker itemised the block and left DSD out of those rows, not because the row was never written.
_vingt_presets_dEGALISEUR_ne_sont_pas_de: This manual's only audio-shaping menu is a 20-preset EQ list plus « Loudness 1 » to « Loudness 16 ». Neither is a reconstruction or interpolation filter, and `device_settings` holds nothing: an equaliser changes the sound deliberately and a digital filter is part of how the conversion works. A harvester counting menu items would have reported thirty-six « filters » on a device that publishes none.
